evidence.text: A person at a terminal benefits from opv prompting them, for example a masked value prompt or a confirmation.
An assistant running opv through a shell cannot answer prompts; a prompt hangs the run or, worse, shows the assistant something it must not see.
The same command is run by both people and assistants.

desiredImprovement: Interactive help for a person at a terminal
worseningOutcome: Reliability and safety when an assistant runs the same command
